dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: That wretched guardian. I was gone for barely a moment, and it's already folded this entire place up...

dialogues.speaker: Amoxcihuatl
dialogues.text: Just as the glorious Holy Sov{RUBY#[D]Ti'sakhuun}ereign Kalomte warned. Beings that transcend humanity must be consumed by the blazing sun's fire...
